# Lambda, Cloud Run, Fargate or EC2: which is cheapest for your traffic?

> Enter requests per month, duration, memory and concurrency and compare the monthly cost of AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Run, AWS Fargate and EC2, plus the request volume where always-on containers become cheaper. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
